findings.title: Conversational and how-to queries return nothing or one unrelated accessory
findings.detail: Zero-result: "a gift for someone who just got an egg". Near-empty or off-target: "how long to smoke a pork butt" (1 product, grade 0), "smoke a ham" (2 products, a convEGGtor and an event listing), "hold the grill at 225" (cookbook, cooler), "what size egg do I need for a family of four" (3 bundles, grade 0). Reproduced on the live results page for all five. The engine is a literal AND matcher with no intent layer. Fix candidate: map common intents (temperature control, sizing, smoking) to collections or content; show a guided empty state.

findings.fix_candidate: Intent-to-collection map and a guided empty state

findings.title: "apron" ranks grills, tables and gloves above the stocked Grilling Apron
findings.detail: The catalog stocks "Grilling Apron". The predictive top 10 does not contain it; the live results page (43 results) leads with Large Big Green Egg and Hell Hands gloves. A single-word product-type query is ranked by loose text overlap. Fix candidate: boost exact product-type/title matches and de-weight the "Big Green Egg" brand token that every title shares.

findings.title: Navigational question "where is my nearest dealer" returns a bare zero
findings.detail: A dealer-locator question gets no results and no pointer. Fix candidate: detect locator intent and link the dealer finder.

findings.title: No kabob/skewer product in the catalog; "kabob" and "skewers" cannot be answered
findings.detail: "kabob" returns zero and "skewers" returns four unrelated tools. The catalog has no skewer SKU (0 of 520). Classified true_empty: search behaves correctly. Whether it is an assortment gap depends on demand, and volumes are pending.

findings.title: Coverage is 99% but answers are shallow
findings.detail: 99% of terms return something, yet 63% of terms have a mean judge grade below 1.5 (0-3 scale). The engine returns the nearest text matches (usually brand-name matches) rather than the right department. The judge under-penalizes cross-category junk, so this is a floor. The predictive endpoint is capped at 10 results, so totals are lower bounds.

verification.selection_rule: every zero-result term (3) + the 5 lowest-mean-grade multi-term informational terms + the lowest single-term product query with a stocked SKU (apron); 9 live results-page GETs, owner-authorized one-off
